name: Oregon

jury_list.statute: ORS 10.215(1): 'Except as specifically provided by law, the State Court Administrator and circuit courts may not disclose source lists obtained from any person or public body, and jury lists containing names selected from a source list, to any other person or public body.' ORS 10.275(1) refers to 'jury records that are confidential under ORS 10.215', released only on a court order in a jury challenge. ORS 10.255: the clerk prepares a record of all persons summoned, specifying '(2) Those who were discharged for ineligibility to act as jurors.' No section says whether that record is closed by 10.215(1). Status: null (Optimus 2026-10-07; reopen candidate).
jury_list.holder: State Court Administrator and circuit courts.

sources.cite: ORS 10.275 (access to confidential jury records only by court order in a jury challenge)
ORS 10.215(1) (source lists and jury lists not disclosed)
ORS 10.255(2) (clerk's record of persons 'discharged for ineligibility to act as jurors')

voter_file.who_may_get: Any person, from the county clerk (requests before the 45th day before an election) or a statewide list from the Secretary of State for $500 (ORS 247.945).
voter_file.permitted_uses: No commercial use, except resale to candidates or political committees for political purposes (ORS 247.955).

sources.cite: ORS 247.948 (public fields include year of birth; birth month and day not disclosed)

private_challenge.who: No private challenge procedure was found. The county clerk may inquire into any registration at any time and cancel it after a hearing (ORS 247.195).

county_board.name: Oregon Secretary of State - county elections officials
county_board.note: The county clerk may inquire into a registration under ORS 247.195.

audit_path.statute: ORS 192.314 (Public Records Law) and 52 U.S.C. 20507(i) (NVRA public inspection of list-maintenance records)
audit_path.what_you_can_request: Counts only, from the county clerk or the Secretary of State: per year, the number of registrations cancelled after an ORS 247.195 inquiry because the registrant was not a U.S. citizen.
audit_path.note: Do not ask for names. No Oregon statute sends juror citizenship answers to election officials. Whether clerks keep counts by reason was not confirmed.

gates.basis: Jury source and jury lists are confidential (ORS 10.215). No private challenge (ORS 247.195 is clerk-led). The status of the ORS 10.255(2) record is unknown (null; reopen candidate). Strict gates: counts only.

notes: CHANGED 2026-10-07: applied under Optimus standing rule (no gate loosens). jury_list statute quoted exactly (10.215(1), 10.275(1)); jury sources 10.215, 10.255, 10.030; audit_path; federal_source_url moved to govinfo. official_pipeline stays null. No gate changes. No voter_file value changes. Later 2026-10-07: Optimus ruled jury_list.public false -> null (reopen candidate; no gate change).

Reopen candidate (Optimus 2026-10-07; REQ-NOTE 61 closed): jury_list.public = null. ORS 10.255 requires 'a record on all persons summoned to serve as jurors for a jury service term in a county, specifying: ... (2) Those who were discharged for ineligibility to act as jurors.' No reason beyond ineligibility is listed. ORS 10.215(1) closes 'jury lists containing names selected from a source list'. Whether the 10.255 record is such a list is not stated. Null keeps counts only. See review/REOPEN.md.
official_pipeline is null: no Oregon statute sends juror citizenship information to election officials. The NCSL table of jury-list pipelines (updated Sept. 1, 2026) does not list Oregon.
Cancelled-voter file: no published Oregon cancelled-voter file with a jury reason code was found. REQ-NOTE 27 drops cancelled rows before matching.
Voter lists may not be used for commercial purposes (ORS 247.955).
ORS 10.215 also limits how courts may use source lists, including voter lists, to jury administration.
